params.note: Documented, multi-factor sizing: capacity = min(available capital, concentration headroom); key is recorded per run. Not a universal pro-rata rule.
Reduces a fund's share; not an eligibility gate

Illustrative pre-trade control under stated assumptions: before a BDC acquires a non-qualifying asset, cap its allocation so that qualifying assets / total assets stays >= 70% after the purchase. Uses the simplified fund_portfolio balance sheet (total and qualifying assets at book value, the new asset added to total assets only). It caps the amount; it does not change the fund's fair share (the allocation key). Not legal advice or a production compliance determination.

Illustrative pre-trade control under stated assumptions (v2, funding-aware): for each BDC, project the balance sheet after the purchase under its funding plan (cash, debt or a cash share; deal plan, else fund default, else unknown). Cash is assumed to count in the 70% basket and to be limited by cash on hand; debt adds to total assets and senior securities. Unknown funding uses the most conservative of the cash and debt cases and raises a High exception to Compliance. Headroom already reserved by other live, unbooked runs is deducted first. Caps the amount, not the allocation weight. To be validated against authoritative guidance and the fund's Legal/Compliance interpretation; not legal advice.

Illustrative operating controls (B07.1): fairness review tolerance (|drift| > tolerance x fair share needs commentary); a submitted run must be approved or rejected within approval_sla_hours; capital and headroom held by a live, unbooked run must be renewed or released by its review-by date (created + reservation_review_hours; a renewal sets a new date, at most that many hours ahead). Nothing is released automatically.
Illustrative, modelled on the 2025 co-investment relief framework

If an affiliate already holds the issuer, a regulated fund needs the board step unless it already holds the issuer and it and every affiliate holder participate in approximate proportion to existing holdings. Illustrative; issuer-level proxy for 'same security'.
